acts.act_title: 1막: 가시덩굴 구릉 모드레쉬 지능목 입찰 사태

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
기사님, 그 지능목
힐러로 쓰시는 건가요?
cuts.visual_prompt: TIER 1 FULL-BLEED RAZORFEN DOWNS DUNGEON ESTABLISHING SHOT inside solid black box frame (edge-to-edge full scenery, outer page margins & gutter below pure #FFFFFF). Sweeping wide cinematic anime interior of Razorfen Downs: gnarled giant dark-brown thorny briar roots curving along the lower stone floor, flickering eerie emerald-green Scourge braziers, soft misty pale-teal open cavern ceiling filling the ENTIRE upper 36% (y=0%..36% completely uncluttered open cavern mist across BOTH top-left for speech bubble and top-right for item tooltip — keep all hoods, vines, and props strictly below y=36%!). In tiny lower-center background, a comical cute cartoon skeleton necromancer mob flees waving bony arms in glowing purple Warlock Fear panic! DYNAMIC ACTING: on lower-left foreground (x=28%), fair-skinned Human Warlock party leader (tucking her plump grumpy red plush Imp doll neatly under one arm so her other hand raises politely) leans forward with a strained super-courteous smile and nervous sweatdrop. On lower-right foreground (x=72%), over-the-shoulder cool indifference of fair-skinned Undead Retribution Paladin (golden warhammer strapped diagonally across her back cape — Clean Hand Rule!) lazily dangling a freshly looted glowing sapphire-blue mystic orb caster pendant necklace from her fingertips with sleepy half-lidded blank golden eyes! Guardrail: fair skin on both girls, strictly zero text.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 모든 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 증가합니다.

LOW-ANGLE SHAMELESS DEADPAN FLEX: positioned cleanly on right 42% (x=74%) facing left, fair-skinned Undead Retribution Paladin (golden warhammer strapped cleanly on her back cape — Clean Hand Rule!) calmly clasps the glowing sapphire-blue mystic orb caster necklace directly around her white-and-gold collar with both gloved hands, wearing utterly unbothered sleepy half-lidded golden eyes, subtle proud chin-tilt, and bright innocent sparkles around the pendant! Guardrail: fair skin, round white skull cap, silver-white bob hair, 0 text.
